depiction.primary_object: isometric wireframe cube or shipping box
modifiers: solid circular clock badge at bottom right
depiction.composition: isometric 3D cube with overlapping clock overlay in lower right corner

readings.meaning: scheduled delivery, pending shipment, or package arrival time
software package build time, cron job, or version history
3D rendering time or queued 3D print job

ambiguity: The plain cube lacks tape strips on top, so it can read as either a physical shipping parcel, a software package/module, or a 3D model.

modifier_semantics.meaning: scheduled, pending, waiting, delivery window, or history

task_intents: schedule a package pickup or delivery
wait for a scheduled shipment window
track a delayed or pending parcel
reschedule a courier delivery time slot
review past order and shipment history

example_tasks.task: Be home between 2 and 4 pm for the freight parcel
Follow up on backordered espresso machine shipment from Seattle Coffee Gear
Hold incoming FedEx packages at Walgreens during our week in Banff
Schedule porch pickup with USPS for the three eBay boxes
Audit npm package build times in the nightly CI pipeline
Queue the 14-hour helmet print on the Bambu overnight
Check customs clearance status on the DHL parcel from Tokyo
Move the recurring diaper subscription shipment back by two weeks so boxes stop piling up
File a lost package claim with carrier if the replacement router hasn't moved by Thursday
Coordinate loading dock time slot with the freight courier for the trade show booth crates

reasoning: An isometric cube or box paired with a clock badge clearly communicates a scheduled delivery, pending shipment, or package waiting on a time window. It fits a very common household and admin task family (tracking parcels, scheduling courier pickups, waiting for deliveries), and in tech contexts also fits software package build times or queued 3D jobs.
